_source: Real papers fetched from the arXiv public API (export.arxiv.org/api/query) on 2026-09-09. Titles and abstracts are verbatim from the real arXiv records; each pair below is two DIFFERENT real papers on a closely related sub-topic -- genuine hard negatives (topically similar, not duplicates), unlike the constructed corpus's easy negatives (unrelated topics).

docs.title: IoT Based Smart Attendance System Using Rfid: A Systematic Literature Review
docs.abstract: This systematic review examines research papers on IoT-based attendance systems using RFID technology. The paper highlights how RFID automation eliminates manual attendance problems like time waste and proxy attendance. Key findings show that automated systems using student card readers provide improved accuracy and reliability compared to traditional signature-based methods, offering institutions a secure alternative for tracking student engagement.
docs.objectives: To review IoT-based attendance systems using RFID technology and eliminate manual attendance problems such as time waste and proxy attendance.

docs.title: ClassVision: AI-Powered Classroom Attendance System
docs.abstract: This research presents an automated classroom attendance solution using face detection and face recognition technology. The system incorporates a user-friendly web interface with real-time image processing to identify and document student presence. The researchers identified RetinaFace as the optimal detection model, achieving strong performance when paired with face recognition algorithms using 50x50 pixel cropped embeddings.
docs.objectives: To present an automated classroom attendance solution using face detection and face recognition technology with a real-time web interface.

docs.title: An Efficient Automatic Attendance System Using Fingerprint Reconstruction Technique
docs.abstract: This paper proposes a fingerprint-based biometric attendance system that eliminates buddy-punching found in traditional methods. The work introduces a novel fingerprint reconstruction algorithm converting phase images to grayscale format. Testing demonstrates that reconstructed fingerprints can effectively launch type-I and type-II attacks against fingerprint recognition systems.
docs.objectives: To propose a fingerprint-based biometric attendance system that eliminates buddy-punching found in traditional methods.

docs.title: Real time face recognition using adaboost improved fast PCA algorithm
docs.abstract: This paper describes a real-time biometric attendance system using face recognition. The system employs AdaBoost with Haar cascade for face detection and combines fast PCA and LDA algorithms for recognition, achieving high accuracy rates in laboratory attendance marking.
docs.objectives: To describe a real-time biometric attendance system using face recognition combining AdaBoost, fast PCA, and LDA algorithms.

docs.title: Smart Inventory Management System for Photovoltaic-Powered Freezer Using Wireless Sensor Network
docs.abstract: An inventory management system for the freezer powered by photovoltaic panels was developed in this study. It aims to promote energy efficiency and the responsible use of food. The system uses Arduino-based wireless sensors to monitor perishable and non-perishable items without manual inspection, with an Android app for data display via GSM.
docs.objectives: To promote energy efficiency and the responsible use of food through an Arduino-based wireless sensor inventory system with an Android monitoring app.

docs.title: Value-Based Inventory Management
docs.abstract: The basic financial purpose of a firm is to maximize its value. An inventory management system should also contribute to realization of this basic aim. The paper presents a model emphasizing enterprise value maximization rather than traditional book profit approaches.
docs.objectives: To present an inventory management model emphasizing enterprise value maximization rather than traditional book profit approaches.

docs.title: An Efficient Intelligent Semi-Automated Warehouse Inventory Stocktaking System
docs.abstract: Introduces an intelligent inventory system addressing data inaccuracy and delayed monitoring. It integrates bar code and distributed flutter application technologies with big data analytics for automated, precise, AI-driven inventory management.
docs.objectives: To address data inaccuracy and delayed monitoring in warehouses using barcode scanning, a Flutter application, and big data analytics.

docs.title: A Blockchain-based Electronic Voting System: EtherVote
docs.abstract: The paper proposes EtherVote, a secure voting platform leveraging Ethereum Blockchain. It emphasizes how blockchain can deliver transparency, immutability, and confidentiality while addressing security and fraud concerns. The system operates without central servers, aiming to enhance privacy and reduce election expenses through decentralized architecture focused on citizen identification.
docs.objectives: To propose a secure Ethereum Blockchain voting platform that delivers transparency, immutability, and confidentiality without central servers.

docs.title: A Trustworthy Electronic Voting System for Australian Federal Elections
docs.abstract: This thesis examines electronic voting design for Australian elections while maintaining security and voter comprehension. It analyzes the iVote WA system used in 2017, identifying security vulnerabilities. The research includes survey data comparing voter trust across three systems: paper-based voting, iVote WA, and vVote, ultimately recommending approaches for future Australian federal election technology.
docs.objectives: To examine electronic voting design for Australian elections, analyze the iVote WA system's vulnerabilities, and compare voter trust across three voting systems.

docs.title: Design of Distributed Voting Systems
docs.abstract: This thesis analyzes real-world electronic voting systems from Estonia, Norway, and Australia, identifying design elements and security challenges. The author proposes a template combining best practices from existing systems and explores blockchain's potential through a modified proof-of-stake mechanism enabling verification on standard devices like smartphones.
docs.objectives: To analyze real-world electronic voting systems and propose a template combining best practices with a modified proof-of-stake blockchain mechanism.

docs.title: Plagiarism Detection - State-of-the-art systems and evaluation methods
docs.abstract: This research examines plagiarism detection systems and their evaluation frameworks. The authors note that plagiarism detection systems comprise various approaches that aim to create a fair environment for academic publications, while acknowledging current limitations in intelligent research plagiarism detection. They provide an overview of evaluation methods, classify recent detection approaches using established taxonomies, and identify future research directions in the field.
docs.objectives: To examine plagiarism detection systems and evaluation frameworks, classify recent detection approaches, and identify future research directions.

docs.title: The Struggle with Academic Plagiarism: Approaches based on Semantic Similarity
docs.abstract: Addressing the challenge that the problem of identifying paraphrasing or obfuscation plagiarism remains unresolved, this paper explores how semantic similarity techniques can strengthen plagiarism detection beyond existing commercial tools like Turnitin and SafeAssign in academic environments.
docs.objectives: To explore how semantic similarity techniques can strengthen plagiarism detection beyond existing commercial tools such as Turnitin and SafeAssign.

docs.title: Evaluating the robustness of source code plagiarism detection tools to pervasive plagiarism-hiding modifications
docs.abstract: This comprehensive evaluation tested source code plagiarism detection tools against student-like obfuscation techniques. Findings reveal tools lack robustness against structural transformations, though JPlag and Plaggie showed relatively better performance, while graph-based tools show potentially greater robustness to pervasive plagiarism-hiding modifications.
docs.objectives: To evaluate the robustness of source code plagiarism detection tools against student-like obfuscation and structural-transformation techniques.

docs.title: Recommender Systems in E-commerce
docs.abstract: E-commerce recommender systems are becoming increasingly important in the current digital world. They are used to personalize user experience, help customers find what they need quickly and efficiently, and increase revenue for the business. The work addresses key obstacles including constrained infrastructure, data retention issues, cold-start challenges, and scalability concerns while examining various system types and future research pathways.
docs.objectives: To examine e-commerce recommender system types and address obstacles including cold-start challenges, scalability, and infrastructure constraints.

docs.title: Intelligent Classification and Personalized Recommendation of E-commerce Products Based on Machine Learning
docs.abstract: The paper examines information overload and the conundrum of choice that personalized systems help resolve. It compares traditional classification approaches with recommendation systems, identifies obstacles such as privacy, algorithmic prejudice, and cold-start problems, then presents a BERT and nearest-neighbor solution tailored for eBay's platform.
docs.objectives: To compare traditional classification with recommendation approaches and present a BERT and nearest-neighbor solution for e-commerce product recommendation.

docs.title: Style4Rec: Enhancing Transformer-based E-commerce Recommendation Systems with Style and Shopping Cart Information
docs.abstract: Style4Rec integrates product visual characteristics and cart data into transformer-based sequential recommendation. Testing demonstrated notable improvements in ranking-quality metrics for e-commerce recommendation over baseline transformer models.
docs.objectives: To integrate product visual style and shopping cart information into a transformer-based e-commerce recommendation model.

docs.title: IoT Book Bot
docs.abstract: The authors develop an automated robotic solution to address overdue book returns in educational libraries. The bot navigates autonomously, scans QR codes and barcodes using Pi Camera and OpenCV, carries books within payload limits, and reduces manual intervention in library circulation processes through mobile app control.
docs.objectives: To develop an autonomous robotic solution that scans QR codes and barcodes to reduce manual intervention in library book-return circulation.

docs.title: Library Information System Audit: Senayan Library Management System (SLiMS) Using ISO 9126
docs.abstract: Researchers evaluate the open-source Senayan Library Management System across ten Indonesian universities using ISO 9126 quality standards. Assessments of functionality, reliability, usability, efficiency, maintainability, and portability demonstrated that SLiMS received very good ratings for college library operations.
docs.objectives: To evaluate the open-source Senayan Library Management System across ten universities using ISO 9126 software quality standards.

docs.title: The Role of UAV-IoT Networks in Future Wildfire Detection
docs.abstract: This research proposes a UAV-IoT network approach for wildfire detection. The authors examine how unmanned aerial vehicles combined with Internet of Things devices can improve detection speed and reliability compared to satellite imaging. Their analysis uses Markov chain modeling to calculate detection probabilities while accounting for sensor limitations like false alarms.
docs.objectives: To propose a UAV-IoT network approach for wildfire detection and model detection probability using Markov chains.

docs.title: Assessing the Efficacy of IoT-based Forest Fire Detection: a Practical Use Case
docs.abstract: This work evaluates practical challenges in implementing distributed sensor networks for forest fire detection. Using real data from the SEA-HAZEMON platform in Thailand, the authors demonstrate obstacles in achieving effective detection and propose design guidelines for 6G-enabled IoT fire detection systems.
docs.objectives: To evaluate practical challenges in distributed sensor networks for forest fire detection using real SEA-HAZEMON platform data from Thailand.

docs.title: SCU-CGAN: Enhancing Fire Detection through Synthetic Fire Image Generation and Dataset Augmentation
docs.abstract: This study presents the SCU-CGAN model combining U-Net and CBAM components to generate synthetic fire images from non-fire images. Testing demonstrates significant improvements in detection model performance when trained on augmented datasets.
docs.objectives: To present a U-Net and CBAM-based model that generates synthetic fire images to augment fire-detection training datasets.

docs.title: Transforming Mentorship: An AI Powered Chatbot Approach to University Guidance
docs.abstract: This research describes an AI mentor system for university students featuring a data processing pipeline that handles CSV files and webpages. The system combines BM25 lexical ranking with ChromaDB semantic retrieval and employs a large language model for generating responses, achieving strong semantic relevance scores.
docs.objectives: To describe an AI mentor chatbot for university students combining BM25 lexical ranking with semantic retrieval and LLM-based responses.

docs.title: Building a Chatbot on a Closed Domain using RASA
docs.abstract: This study constructed a closed-domain chatbot using the RASA framework with SVM, CRF, and LSTM models. The system was trained on a technology college's information with multiple intents, sentence patterns, entities, and stories.
docs.objectives: To construct a closed-domain university information chatbot using the RASA framework with SVM, CRF, and LSTM models.

docs.title: NOVI: Chatbot System for University Novice with BERT and LLMs
docs.abstract: NOVI helps university freshmen adapt to campus life using a large language model trained on community forum data from a university platform, evaluated through multiple performance metrics to support newcomers navigating new academic environments.
docs.objectives: To help university freshmen adapt to campus life using an LLM-based chatbot trained on community forum data.
